title.zh: 增加萨马省Allen市镇急诊医院床位并授权为此追加拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Allen Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Allen, Province of Samar, and Authorizing the Additional Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Increasing the Bed Capacity of Allen Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Allen, Province of Samar, and Authorizing the Additional Appropriation of Funds Therefor

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3864_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The bed capacity of Allen Emergency Hospital in the Municipality of Allen, Province of Samar, is hereby increased from twenty-five to fifty.

Additional sum necessary in accordance with the provisions of Republic Act Numbered Nineteen hundred thirty-nine is hereby authorized to be appropriated to carry out the purposes of this Act for the fiscal year nineteen hundred and sixty-five, in addition to its existing appropriations. Thereafter, said sums shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1964.
